name: Low Mill
need: Keep the grain road usable without turning the settlement into a military storehouse.

consequences.summary: Both ends of Miller's Road remain dependable. Low Mill's council commits grain and repair timber to the next defense.
Miller's Road survives under guard. Low Mill sends one careful cart while its council waits to see whether the route can hold.
The defended route cannot guarantee passage. Low Mill's council keeps its stores home and waits for a safer road.
